meta.title: Update VM const reuse and refresh TPC‑DS IR
meta.body_summary: Reuse constant registers when building grouped records in VM compiler; update TPC-DS IR disassembly for queries q60–q69.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex proposed VM constant reuse with TPC-DS IR test updates; merged quickly with no reviews or performance benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 463 changed lines across 10 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor. The performance claim is implicit in the compiler improvement; the quick merge without review is consistent with a low-risk, test-update-only change.

review_details.concern_detail: No reviews were performed; the PR was merged immediately by the author.
review_details.performance_claim: Reusing constant registers in the VM reduces the number of constant objects created, potentially improving memory and compile time.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR modifies the VM compiler to reuse constant registers, a low-level optimization that requires understanding the VM's register allocation. The agent successfully made the change and updated multiple test IR files, but without providing performance evidence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR updates TPC-DS IR test outputs, so correctness can be verified by running the provided Go tests. However, no before/after performance metrics are included, so the performance claim is not directly reproducible.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions were flagged; the PR merged without issue.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, modified the compiler to reuse existing constant registers when building grouped records; updated TPC-DS query IR disassembly files in tests/dataset/tpc-ds/out/ to reflect the new compiler output.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The secondary files are test expectation IR outputs that were changed to match the new compiler behavior. They account for the majority of line changes (449 out of 463 lines).
change_trajectory: Single commit: 'runtime/vm: reuse group constants' modifies vm.go and all TPC-DS IR test files.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by OpenAI_Codex with compiler constant reuse and test updates.
PR merged by tamnd within 7 minutes with no reviews or comments.
